title: cleanup_tmp_files: successful removal logged as warn instead of info
description: relay_queue.rs lines 215-218: 'removed orphan tmp file from previous crash' is logged as warn!(). An orphan tmp file after a crash is the expected recovery path — it is informational, not anomalous. warn!() implies something unexpected that needs operator attention. info!() is the correct level for 'found and cleaned up a crash artifact'. The failure case (could not remove) should remain warn!(). Suggested rewrite: change warn!(...'removed orphan tmp file...') to info!(...).
